claim: The cellar row record's invoice book (INVOICE_LINE_COLUMNS in apps/api-gateway/src/beverages/beverages.service.ts) embeds the vendor through the FK hint providers!procurement_documents_provider_id_fkey(name) and reads doc_number, which the line's note uses (A-043, A-044, 2026-10-03 analytics walk). procurement_documents and providers are joined by two foreign keys (procurement_documents.provider_id, and providers.created_from_document_id from migration a_vendor_is_resolved_by_identity), so a bare providers(name) made PostgREST refuse the whole read with 'more than one relationship' and the card said 'invoices unread'. The verify holds while that literal carries the hint and doc_number, that migration still declares created_from_document_id as a reference to procurement_documents(id) (the reason the hint is needed), and no procurement_documents(...) embed written in a .ts file under apps/api-gateway/src (spec files excepted, nesting up to three levels) names providers( or providers!inner( / providers!left( without an FK hint. It does not see a select issued on procurement_documents itself, or an embed assembled at runtime. Mutation-tested 2026-10-03: origin/main's beverages.service.ts makes it exit 1.

claim: /cellar's three menu readers count only the lines on the house's current menu (ADR 0193: restaurant_menus.status = 'active'; several active menus are read as one union), not every kept copy (A-028 / F-148: 267 lines read for a 134-line menu, because the archived copy was counted too). The verify holds while (a) in the newest migration that defines public.house_beverage_ledger, the menu CTE (comments stripped) joins public.restaurant_menus rm ON rm.id = mi.menu_id as an inner join (a LEFT, RIGHT or FULL join keeps every line, because the status test sits in the ON clause, and brings the double count back) and keeps rm.status = 'active' (migration the_ledger_lists_only_the_current_menu); (b) neither apps/api-gateway/src/cellar/cellar-registers.service.ts nor apps/api-gateway/src/beverages/beverages.service.ts calls .from('menu_items'), and both call readCurrentMenuLines(; (c) apps/api-gateway/src/menus/current-menu-lines.ts reads restaurant_menus with .eq('status', 'active'), reads lines with .in('menu_id', ...) and leaves out .neq('status', 'discarded') lines. It checks that these calls are present, not how they are chained (current-menu-lines.spec.ts and the SQL test of migration the_ledger_lists_only_the_current_menu under supabase/tests pin the behaviour). Mutation-tested 2026-10-03: origin/main's two services, or origin/main's newest ledger migration alone, or the new migration with LEFT JOIN in place of JOIN, each make it exit 1.

claim: /cellar's 'Carried, not in the wine library' figure (named 'Carried but off this read' until ADR 0293; BuildingVM.offBook in apps/web/src/pages/cellar/next/useCellarNextData.ts) counts the house's inventory rows that carry no wineId, and no longer compares them with the wine-library pages loaded so far (A-053: 119 of 134 on first load, from code). The two are the same set because restaurant_inventory_master_wine_id_fkey is a foreign key to the library, so a linked row's title is in it under any delete action (it is ON DELETE RESTRICT today, migration the_house_item_is_the_ledgers_key), and GET /wines filters no library row out (searchWines in apps/api-gateway/src/wines/wines.service.ts applies only the caller's own filters), a premise this row does not re-check. The verify holds while exactly one offBook: expression reads rows, it names wineId and names neither known nor bottles, the building memo's dependency list does not name bottles, that migration still adds the constraint ON DELETE RESTRICT, and no later migration names the constraint. The tile's label and source line are pinned by CELLAR-OFFBOOK-TILE-NAMES-THE-LIBRARY (ADR 0293). Mutation-tested 2026-10-03: origin/main's useCellarNextData.ts makes it exit 1.
